phases.name: Test the tools
phases.label: Phase 1
phases.milestone: 4 games filmed and logged, AI vs. me

phases.name: Build your review method
phases.label: Phase 2
phases.milestone: 3 free reviews delivered, each under about 60 minutes

phases.name: Markup basics
phases.label: Level 1
phases.milestone: One clip with drawing and voiceover

tasks.title: Build a reusable template
tasks.detail: Intro, name strip, outro you can drop any clip into.

tasks.title: Deliver the free reviews
tasks.detail: Time each one and add it to the review tracker.

tasks.title: Practice markup in Kinovea
tasks.detail: Free, Windows. Lines, angles, slow motion, frame-by-frame.

tasks.title: Write your own read of game 1
tasks.detail: Before opening any AI stats. Patterns, technique, decisions.

tasks.title: Recruit 2–3 players for free reviews
tasks.detail: Students or friends who'll film a game and give honest feedback.

tasks.title: Make a 2-minute recorded breakdown
tasks.detail: Kinovea markup recorded through OBS with commentary.

tasks.title: Run game 1 through PB Vision
tasks.detail: Buy the 300-minute pack ($39.99). Videos must be under 20 minutes.

tasks.title: Run game 1 through SwingVision
tasks.detail: One month at $14.99. Same video, side by side.

tasks.title: Export and post a vertical clip
tasks.detail: 9:16 for Instagram or TikTok.

tasks.title: Film game 1
tasks.detail: Camera at least 4 ft high with all four court corners in frame.

tasks.title: Decide on the OnForm paid plan
tasks.detail: $29.99/month, or switch to the free desktop tools.

tasks.title: Write the offer and filming guide
tasks.detail: A short description plus how players should film their game.

tasks.title: Map common faults to drills
tasks.detail: Pull from your drill library so each priority has a ready drill.

tasks.title: Draft your review template
tasks.detail: 5 key rallies → 3 priorities → matching drills.

tasks.title: Create a repeat package
tasks.detail: e.g. monthly review or a 3-review progress pack.

tasks.title: Ask for testimonials
tasks.detail: One or two sentences you can quote.

tasks.title: Repeat for games 2–4
tasks.detail: Your read first, then the tools, then the log.

tasks.title: Set your price and bundle
tasks.detail: Review alone at $40–75, plus a review + private lesson bundle.

tasks.title: Learn edit basics
tasks.detail: DaVinci Resolve or CapCut: titles, arrows, freeze-frames, picture-in-picture.

tasks.title: Decide on DUPR Coach
tasks.detail: $250/year. Adds video ratings and a listing on the DUPR Coach Map.

tasks.title: Mark up one clip in OnForm
tasks.detail: Draw lines, add a voiceover, share it to yourself.

tasks.title: Deliver your first paid review
tasks.detail: Log it in the review tracker.

tasks.title: Ask about offering it at 3rd Shot
tasks.detail: Keep the request short.

tasks.title: Set up a phone mount
tasks.detail: Tall tripod or fence clip, elevated behind the baseline. Ask whether 3rd Shot courts have cameras.

tasks.title: Pick which AI tool to keep
tasks.detail: Cancel the other before it renews.

tasks.title: Confirm RPO qualifies for DUPR Coach
tasks.detail: Requires a current certification from a recognized organization.

tasks.title: Start the OnForm free trial
tasks.detail: 14 days. Time it so the trial covers your free reviews.

tasks.title: Log game 1 in the AI vs. me log
tasks.detail: What you caught, what the AI caught, what it missed.

tasks.title: Record a test with OBS
tasks.detail: Free. Screen plus your voice; check audio levels.

tasks.title: Publish an AI vs. coach breakdown video
tasks.detail: Marketing piece built from your comparison log.
